title: Firestop sealant, alternate product
summary: The firestop sealant submittal can be approved pending clarification on a few missing details that don’t affect performance but are needed for full compliance verification.

findings.title: Not stated: VOC (air quality)
findings.detail: VOC lower than SCAQMD 1168 requires (250 g/L: the Rule 1168 architectural sealant limit; the number comes from the rule, not the spec).
findings.why_it_matters: Verifying VOC levels ensures the sealant meets air quality rules and won’t cause issues during indoor installation.

findings.title: Couldn't compare: ASTM G21 rating
findings.why_it_matters: Confirming mold resistance helps ensure the sealant will hold up in damp areas over time without degrading.

highlights.quote:
Mold and mildew performance
Class 0 (ASTM G21-96)

findings.title: Not stated: Test standards
findings.detail: Tested in accordance with ASTM E814, ASTM E119 or UL 1479.
findings.why_it_matters: Documenting the correct test standard proves the sealant was evaluated properly for fire containment in wall and floor penetrations.

findings.title: Different revision found; no quoted values changed
findings.detail: Submitted 12/16 DBS, web source DBS • 03/25. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: While the revision dates differ, we can’t tell which version is newer without clearer labeling—so we’re noting it for tracking, not rejecting based on age.
